decisions.decision: For a broadside move, every corresponding destination pit must be on the board and empty.
Expose exactly one forced pass if and only if the active player has no legal movement. Never expose a voluntary pass while a movement exists.
The sixth ejection ends the game immediately, leaves current_player as the winner, and exposes no terminal legal actions.
Returns are [0, 0] before terminal and [+1, -1] from player-ID order for a player-0 win, reversed for a player-1 win.
Exactly one canonical serialized action represents each physical movement; group-order aliases and duplicate successor transitions are forbidden.
The canonical public contract exposes complete board occupancy, current player, capture counts, terminal status, winner, phase, and move number.
Software player 0 controls black and player 1 controls white; black/player 0 moves first.
